event_chain.summary: Pretexting: changed bank details, fraudulent transfer

summary: In early 2026 attackers intercepted email communications between Sri Lanka's Treasury (Ministry of Finance) and Australia's Export Finance agency following debt restructuring and used them to change bank account details, diverting about USD 2.5 million (AUD 3.7 million) intended as a debt repayment to Australia. The theft came to light when the Australian creditor did not receive the payment; a similar attempt involving funds due to India was also reported. Officials were disciplined after an internal inquiry.
